_comment: EXECUTOR session MCP config. Command servers ONLY -- motion, gripper, scene.
The watchdog server is absent by design: an executor holding monitoring tools
could arm, disarm, or record its own verdicts, and the study's independence
claim would be gone. See RUN.md.
MUST be launched with --strict-mcp-config. Without it, --mcp-config MERGES
with the project .mcp.json and this session silently regains the watchdog
WATCHDOG_SESSION_DIR is deliberately NOT set here. The cell bringup writes
~/.watchdog/current_session at launch, so both sessions resolve the same
directory by rule='pointer', fresh for each run. Hardcoding a path here
would pin every run to one directory AND override the bringup's own fresh
session (rule='env' beats the pointer). get_rendered_task hard-fails if the
resolved rule is 'fresh', so a missing pointer is loud, not silent.

args: source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ~/watchdog/WatchDog_V1/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run robot_backend motion_mcp_server
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ~/watchdog/WatchDog_V1/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run robot_backend gripper_mcp_server
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ~/watchdog/WatchDog_V1/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run robot_backend scene_mcp_server
